_README: One Pin package per article. Images are generated by `python tools/make_pins.py` into pinterest-pins/<article>/. pool: initial (scheduled launch pool) | reserve (kept as later creative variations, no date). board = one of the 5 launch boards; laterSeasonalBoard = where to also save it once that seasonal board exists. Status: draft -> ready (reviewed by Intesar) -> published (posted by hand, add pinUrl). Never auto-post. Soft launch: no product promises, prices, 'shop the look' or affiliate wording.
